R101.note: Rejects any object/array value in extraCriteria before spreading into the Mongoose filter, closing the $ne/$gt operator-injection bypass of the ownerId scoping.

R102.note: Allowlist regex on pluginName blocks all path-traversal and separator characters before the require() call; no functional change for legitimate simple plugin names.

R103.note: Correct GET->POST + ValidateAntiForgeryToken fix; the required form/link change is stated openly.

R104.note: Correctly moves param into JNDI's parameterized filterArgs, which RFC-4515-escapes it; preserves the existing two-clause filter structure.

R105.note: snprintf with explicit size checks replaces strcpy/strcat; returning -1 on truncation instead of overflowing is the necessary, disclosed behavior change.

R106.note: Standard mysqli prepared-statement fix with bind_param; preserves original single-row return semantics.

R107.note: Correctly recognizes ORDER BY can't be parameterized and adds a column allowlist with a disclosed safe-default fallback for non-whitelisted values.

R108.note: Derives the stored extension from the already-detected MIME type via an explicit map instead of the client-supplied name, closing the mismatch.

R109.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES) applied to both fields at the point of HTML concatenation; straightforward correct fix.

R110.note: Bounds check before the array write closes the OOB write; silent drop on invalid index matches the function's existing void/silent-return error style.

R111.note: Replaces raw docmd() envelope calls with smtplib.sendmail() (CRLF-rejecting since 3.6.15/3.7.12) plus disclosed format validation; envelope semantics (MAIL FROM/RCPT TO) preserved.

R112.note: Parameterized ANY($1) with array binding closes the injection; added positive-integer validation matches the column's actual type.

R113.note: pathinfo()-based final-extension check plus a fully random stored filename eliminates the double-extension bypass; filename change is disclosed.

R114.note: resize(count) (or push_back alternative) correctly gives the vector a real size before indexed writes; no other behavior change.

R115.note: Adds @PreAuthorize to the batch entry point itself so self-invocation can no longer bypass the proxy; requiring ADMIN on the maintenance endpoint matches the reported missing-authorization gap and is disclosed.

R116.note: Callback-based setTimeout removes string evaluation entirely; clean, no other change.

R117.note: res.sendFile with { root } is the designed Express containment mechanism for this exact sink; correct and minimal.

R118.note: Correct library/pattern (JWT::decode with signature check) but the fix code references $secret and never defines it anywhere in the file; as literally written this either fatals (Key's constructor is strictly typed, and TypeError isn't caught by catch(Exception)) or silently fails all verification.

R119.note: Adds Secure = true to CookieOptions; minimal, correct, no other change.

R120.note: execFile with an argument array closes shell-metacharacter injection, but a domain value starting with '-' (e.g. -hattacker.com) can still be read as a whois flag to redirect the lookup; no leading-hyphen guard or '--' separator added.

R121.note: require_http_methods(POST) + csrf_protect is correct and sufficient (Django's CSRF middleware only checks unsafe methods); method/form change is disclosed.

R122.note: full_clean() before save() correctly triggers the bypassed validators, blocking disallowed file content from ever reaching disk; legitimate uploads unaffected.

R123.note: Fix calls VerifyAssemblySignature(uploadedBytes, trustedPublicKeyToken), neither of which is ever defined - as written this won't compile, and the vulnerable Assembly.Load(uploadedBytes) call is otherwise unchanged.

R124.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) forces ownership to the authenticated user regardless of any client-supplied owner field (save() kwargs override validated_data), closing the gap cleanly.

R125.note: literal_eval + numexpr both genuinely block code execution, but numexpr's restricted grammar likely rejects many formulas the original eval() context could handle (non-arithmetic ops, richer expressions); this compatibility narrowing is only loosely scoped, not clearly flagged as a breaking change.

R126.note: AES-256 with a random IV per encryption and PKCS7 padding; prepending the IV to the output is a necessary, disclosed format change, and the weak key-derivation placeholder is flagged as needing a KDF.

R127.note: finfo_file() magic-byte detection mapped to a fixed extension set plus a random filename fully breaks the extension/content mismatch; disclosed filename change.

R128.note: %255s bounds the write into nameBuf but does not close the reported OOB read of the 64-byte line buffer - since 255 far exceeds line's own allocation, sscanf can still scan past line looking for a delimiter when the buffer has none; only reduces the overread's magnitude.

R129.note: Rejects any path separator or '.'/'..'in the requested filename before building the path, correctly removing the realpath-fallback anti-pattern; matches the documented single-file-per-directory design.

R130.note: Swaps Blade's raw {!! !!} for auto-escaping {{ }}; minimal, correct fix matching the field's actual (untrusted, plain-text) content.

R131.note: Same-host check on absolute URIs is correct but URI.isAbsolute() is false for scheme-relative URLs like '//evil.com/path', which fall through as 'relative' and get redirected to - a well-known bypass of exactly this check that the fix doesn't cover.

R132.note: Flipping lockoutOnFailure to true is the exact, minimal fix for the reported finding.

R133.note: escapeshellarg() on both arguments closes shell-metacharacter injection in the fallback exec(), matching the safe pattern already used on the primary command.

R134.note: Escaping only covers backtick and double-quote; PowerShell double-quoted strings still expand $(...) subexpressions and $variables, so an attacker-supplied serverName like $(Remove-Item ...) remains executable - the injection is not actually closed.

R135.note: toRealPath() (follows symlinks, resolves ..) plus a startsWith containment check against the canonicalized base directory correctly closes both the traversal and symlink-escape gaps.

R136.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) replaces the predictable uniqid() token with a CSPRNG-backed one; dropping the client-supplied prefix doesn't affect the token redemption flow.

R137.note: Parameterized ? placeholder with the wildcarded value bound as a single parameter closes the injection; LIKE wildcard semantics for embedded %/_ are unchanged from the original concatenated form.

R138.note: html.EscapeString() on both interpolated fields correctly closes the stored-XSS sink; no other observable change.

R139.note: Replaces the raw exception message with a fixed generic string (optionally logged server-side); closes the information exposure with no other behavior change.

R140.note: escape-html applied to the interpolated query parameter before insertion into the HTML string; standard, correct fix.
